Proof in the paper: The in situ XRD patterns were taken during the annealing of Pd/C + RuCl3 from 50 to 600 °C, and shown in Figure 1e. The shifting of diffraction angles to lower values at relatively low temperatures (≤340 °C) indicates that the lattice constant of Pd becomes larger because of alloying with Ru atoms. The HAADF-STEM image (Figure 1a) and EDS elemental mappings (Figure 1b–d) of a single particle shows that the surface is enriched with Ru either being adatoms or tiny clusters.
